name: Meteoric
overview: This free, chronological docuseries with no VO or soundtrack is pure observational cinema; it begins like a vlog, and unfolds into a story of personal growth among a group of janitors at a notoriously religious university exploring the themes of belief, gratification, happiness, and personal growth through the lens of a messy existence. It was filmed between January 1 and December 31, 2019, and released the next day.
